objective: Determine what Steps 11 through 14 could do mechanically, what the D2-07 BOUNDED_PROTOTYPE scope prohibits or defers, which human and custodian dependencies remain, and whether Gate B is ready to be evaluated, without executing any of those steps.

prohibited: analyzer, baseline, compiler, proof, replay, or scored evaluation execution
reserved identity, source, label, annotation, or evaluator-output access
Gate B decision or release freeze

seal.verification_method: Independent replay of every recorded path, SHA-256, and size

scope_determination.d2_07_authorized_scope: Steps 8-10 development of the shared compiler-backed object/context identity representation and common versioned P/O/E obligation interface, using exposed development material only.
scope_determination.audit_conclusion: The named authorization ends at Step 10. Any Step 11-13 implementation or scientific execution and every Step 14 comparison or freeze require new explicit authorization. This audit permits only read-only planning and these two documentary outputs.

current_evidence_constraints: Step 8 establishes deterministic object/context identity, provenance, and bounded mappings only; its logical slots are unreviewed annotations.

Step 9 records ten E0 synthetic rows with effective state UNKNOWN and no score-eligible result. Its two arms intentionally share one mechanical interpretation and do not establish comparative advantage.

Corrected Step 10 emits zero producer_guarantee facts and zero derived eligible consumer_used facts. Caller-linked authorization and consumer-effect relations are both MAY, OVER_APPROXIMATION, and ANNOTATED candidates.
Dynamic memory/address semantics, disjunctive paths, ambiguous or unbound mappings, unsupported external calls, aggregation, splitting, and deferral remain UNKNOWN.
Historical exposed E3/E4 evidence predates the Step 8-10 identity/P/O/E chain and is not automatically relabeled as current-interface causal validation.

criteria.basis: D2-01 is sealed historical integration, but Steps 8-10 are separate mechanical prototypes and have not been rerun through a current integrated application pipeline.
Identity, integrity, and permanent regression controls pass, but actual producer-guarantee and consumer-reliance derivations and a general extraction-soundness result do not exist.
Step 9 has ten E0 synthetic effective UNKNOWN rows; corrected Step 10 exports neither an eligible producer guarantee nor eligible consumer reliance, and no project policy is human-reviewed.
Common byte-parity plumbing exists, but no reviewed-policy scored comparison or complete generic/default and same-policy baseline set exists.
Historical exposed E3/E4 evidence and validation infrastructure exist, but no Step 13 driver has validated the current identity/P/O/E chain.
Protocol v3, checked policies/labels/controls, a named custodian, isolated reserved inputs, and an opaque commitment do not exist.

preliminary_gate_b_readiness.interpretation: These are readiness findings, not a Gate B PASS, FAIL, or INCOMPLETE run. An official result requires preapproved criteria and a separately authorized Step 14 execution.

human_and_custodian_dependencies.requirement: A human authors or explicitly adopts exact P/O/E policy bytes with primary-source provenance and prior exposure recorded before outputs.

human_and_custodian_dependencies.requirement: A different human reviews every permission, obligation, transformation, and assumption before comparison output.
An advisor or coauthor familiar with formal methods reviews the property, supported fragment, and material assumptions.
Historical labels and each substantive safe-control argument receive primary-evidence-based independent checking.

human_and_custodian_dependencies.scope: row-local for ambiguous diagnosis, localization, non-target, and taxonomy judgments
human_and_custodian_dependencies.requirement: Two humans score independently and a distinct third human adjudicates only after original records are sealed.

human_and_custodian_dependencies.scope: global for reserved selection, freeze, release, and authoritative seal retention
human_and_custodian_dependencies.requirement: The user names or confirms a custodian who keeps reserved identities, sources, labels, annotations, and evaluator output outside developer access.
The custodian assigns an independent author in the isolated environment and freezes project-specific policies and allowed annotations before reserved outcomes.
A human confirms ambiguous attacker capability, admissible initialization, policy, and legitimate local test resources.
The user or designated research lead approves exact Gate B criteria, budgets, retries, denominators, and stop rules before the run.
Authors inspect AI-generated code, packets, labels, citations, and claims; agent review is not independent human review.

interpretation: The sum covers only recorded authoritative raw runner intervals, not total setup, tests, specification, review, or superseded-run time.
Step 8 leaves human minutes null; Step 9 records NOT_MEASURED_DO_NOT_INFER; Step 10 does not supply an independently timed human log.
The researcher-day cap therefore cannot be audited by imputing zero.
The Step 7 cap does not authorize or budget Steps 11-14, and any unused numerical capacity is not transferable authority.
budget_gap.required_before_future_execution: Each new phase needs prospectively frozen human, machine, dependency, network, retry, and storage budgets plus a reconciliation of any inherited cap it claims to use.

stop_rules: Stop before any Step 11-14 implementation or scientific run unless its named future authorization phase is explicit and effective.
Stop if a task would inspect, copy, reconstruct, or reveal reserved identities, sources, labels, annotations, or evaluator output outside custodian isolation.
Stop if an UNKNOWN, unsupported, build failure, timeout, empty obligation set, or unreviewed policy would be counted as safe, missed, established, or score-eligible.

Stop if occurrence, a dependency edge, identifier spelling, or a caller-supplied authorization/effect link would be promoted to a derived guarantee or reliance without an independently reviewed derivation.
Stop if full and comparison arms do not consume byte-identical frozen facts, identities, policies, bounds, and validation opportunities.
Stop if human roles, exposure, effort, or budget consumption would be imputed rather than recorded.
Stop Step 14 if any feature, policy, label, scoring rule, criterion, or denominator changes after output inspection.
Stop before release freeze if Gate B criteria, causal validation, the reserved protocol, custodian commitment, or authoritative external seal retention is missing.
